title: Someone taught you the first thing you ever got good at. Som...
caption:
Someone taught you the first thing you ever got good at. Someone will teach the person who builds India's next big thing.

On Teachers' Day, the reminder is simple: the sectors, skills, and careers we talk about every day all trace back to a classroom. Growth doesn't skip that step — it starts there.
